Name: Kichjo's Goats Before Cows for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I got a request to update Kichjo's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5564](BFAV) Goats Before Cows[/url] and permissions were open, so here it is! Pretty self-explanatory, it unlocks goats with the regular barn instead of cows, and cows are now unlocked at the Big Barn level (because frankly, a newbie farmer would have an easier time of taking care of a goat before a cow lol)

Enjoy!
